endorsements.quote: However, successful implementation requires robust IT infrastructure, seamless integration with electronic health records, and careful consideration of ethical and privacy concerns.

Irrespective of these favorable premises, caution must be exercised in carefully supervising all AIgenerated recommendations, and this holds even truer in the elderly, given the complex riskbenefit balance and their greater frailty burden.(34)

unlisted_practices: Foster ongoing collaboration between technologists and healthcare professionals to integrate AI tools effectively and address implementation challenges.
Ensure healthcare settings have a functional, modern IT support network with fully incorporated electronic medical records before deploying LLM tools.
Prioritize patient dignity and privacy and maintain human oversight in AI-driven care for vulnerable populations such as the elderly.
